parcel_master.verification_note: Phase 2 build: per operator direction the parcel-master ingest is the NYS GIS Clearinghouse statewide public tax-parcel layer (layer 1). Greene County is one of the 36 counties that opted into public sharing; COUNTY_NAME='Greene' returns 38,418 parcels (verified 2026-05-21). The 74-field schema includes SBL/PRINT_KEY, PARCEL_ADDR, PRIMARY_OWNER, MAIL_* owner address, LAND_AV/TOTAL_AV/FULL_MARKET_VAL, PROP_CLASS. The GAR Associates PROS portal (greenecounty.prosgar.com) remains a verified per-parcel alternative, but bulk ArcGIS is the chosen ingest. scrapers/parcel_master.py normalizes to framework-canonical field names, so no field_map is required.

build_verdict_reason: Corrected after the 2026-05-21 primary-event-source re-recon. At least one verified PRIMARY event source is publicly accessible and stdlib-reachable: the AAR / NYSauctions tax-foreclosure auction (server-rendered, confirmed Greene auction 6892, 51 lots) — the buildable Phase 3 target — plus the Treasurer's annual in-rem tax-foreclosure petition. The County Clerk land records (SearchIQS) and the NYS court portals (NYSCEF / WebCivil / Surrogate's) are verified live but Cloudflare-challenge-gated: not stdlib-reachable, buildable via an operator-seeded session / stealth browser (approved §02.9 / §4.14 strategies). Column legal notices are a published-notice path pending API discovery. Enrichment (NYS parcel layer, county GIS, ProsGar assessment, tentative roll) is available. Verdict: READY_WITH_BLOCKERS — a partial build proceeds now on the stdlib-reachable tax-foreclosure auction; the clerk/court sources unblock when seeded-session infrastructure is provided.

api_discovery.search_notes: 2026-05-21 re-recon. No documented public API for the primary lead sources. SearchIQS and the NYS court portals (NYSCEF / WebCivil) are Cloudflare-challenge-gated — adapters need an operator-seeded session. AAR Auctions (aarauctions.com) is server-rendered WordPress/servlet — no API needed, plain-HTTP stdlib-reachable. Column (newyork.column.us) is a Next.js SPA: the api.column.us backend host responds but no documented search endpoint was found — API discovery or browser tooling required. Documented APIs (ArcGIS) exist only for the GIS / parcel enrichment layer.
